result.boundary: Programmable raster draws merge by material and state buffer; material tiles for every shading bin come from three dispatches over the shading mask. Exact frozen-clock depth and material comparisons, mask/PDO/WPO fixtures in both visibility formats with the new path on and off, recovery and eligibility pass. Performance rows are single first-tour runs; rows with different foreground windows are not comparable, and instrumented rows are not frame-rate evidence. Readbacks, images, large per-test reports, engine logs, CPU profiles and traces are recorded by hash only and remain in results/. Two-round HZB is slower than one round in the accepted scene; full enabled performance acceptance stays open.
